history.content: I feel completely hopeless and nothing makes me happy anymore
That sounds like a really tough place to be. Can you tell me more about what's been going on that's making you feel this way?
I feel like a burden on everyone around me
That can be a really heavy feeling to carry. What makes you think that you're a burden to others, is it something specific that's happened or just a feeling you've been having lately?
I dont want to get out of bed in the morning
That can be a really tough way to start the day. What's going through your mind when you wake up and you just don't feel like getting out of bed?
I feel like I am disappearing and no one would notice

That's a really powerful and painful feeling. It sounds like you're feeling like you're becoming invisible, like you're fading away and no one would even miss you. Can you tell me more about what that feels like for you, what's going through your mind when you feel like you're disappearing?
I dont see any future for myself

That can be a really scary and hopeless feeling. Not being able to see a future for yourself can make it feel like you're stuck in a never-ending void. I want to help you explore ways to start imagining a more positive future, even if it feels small right now. Have you thought about what you'd like your life to look like, say, a year from now?
